messages:
lucy: quick question on PR #4930 (disconnected preflight) 1 1 the example in the DNS section shows raw IPs in /etc/hosts for KMS/HSM. QA flagged this as "looks required". do we have a canonical wording for hostname vs IP for private KMS endpoints?
jun: short answer: prefer hostnames + certs. long-form: recommend a resolvable hostname with TLS cert (CN or SAN) that matches the hostname. /etc/hosts or IP-based cert SANs are allowed only as a bootstrap/fallback for air-gapped installs.
lucy: can we add a tiny example that shows hostname-first, then a fallback /etc/hosts block? makes the intent clearer.
nate: while you're at it, add a troubleshooting note about hairpin/NAT. common failure mode: control-plane requests to an internal IP fail when SNAT prevents loopback. call out NAT loopback or enable hairpin on the cluster gateway.
rachel: security addendum: never suggest skipping hostname validation in examples. if you must show an IP-based entry, include a curl that validates the cert instead of --insecure. example:
```
# validate via explicit resolve and CA bundle
curl --resolve "kms.prod.local:443:10.10.0.5"
  --cacert /etc/kms/ca.pem
  https://kms.prod.local/healthz
```
samir: HSM note: PKCS#11 config is vendor-specific. include a vendor-agnostic snippet and link to vendor docs for slot discovery. also remind folks some HSMs expose admin/management on a separate NIC so firewall rules must allow mgmt traffic. snippet suggestion:
```
pkcs11:
  library: /usr/lib/libpkcs11-example.so  # vendor path
  token: "hsm-token-01"
  slot: 0  # may vary; please check vendor tool
  pin_env: HSM_PIN          # prefer env var, not inline secret
```
emily: doc nit: the anchor for cert provisioning moved from `#certs-provisioning` to `#cert-provisioning` in the guide, so two links in the disconnected doc 404. i pushed a tiny commit that fixes both links.
jun: great, i'll reword the DNS section to: 1) use hostname + cert example, 2) show /etc/hosts as last-resort bootstrap, 3) add rachel's curl validate example, 4) put nate's hairpin paragraph under troubleshooting, and 5) add samir's pkcs11 snippet to the HSM appendix.
lucy: also please add a one-line cert rule near the top: "Cert CN or SAN must match the hostname used by clients; avoid IP CN unless SAN includes the IP." we saw a customer break because they used an IP CN only.
rachel: exact wording suggestion: "Cert CN/SAN MUST include the hostname clients use; prefer hostname-based certs. If assigning IPs in /etc/hosts, include the IP in the cert SAN or use hostname-based certs instead."
jun: will use that exact text. i'll squash and ping for final review.
docs-bot: docs-ci: build for PR #4930 succeeded (:white_check_mark:)
emily: LGTM after the hairpin troubleshooting line lands. small thumbs up. :thumbsup:
lucy: thanks — i'll update the internal changelog note to "disconnected preflight: clarified KMS/HSM addressing, cert CN/SAN guidance, added PKCS#11 sample, and hairpin NAT troubleshooting."
jun: merging after quick tidy.

# Preflight checklist (to include in the doc):
# - DNS: hostname resolvable or /etc/hosts present for bootstrap
# - Certs: CN/SAN must match hostname used by clients
# - HSM: PKCS#11 lib path configured; management NIC allowed in firewall
# - Networking: hairpin/NAT if control-plane behind SNAT
